method: HOUSECARL_SKILL_AUTHORING.md §6.5 manual/fan-out validation (run_loop.py uses select(), broken on Windows per §6.4). FULL RE-RUN 2026-06-11 against the read-framed description (HCBR-2026-06-11-03 fix: 'Author or interpret', read-side audit cases, 'before writing or reading' closing): all 20 original queries re-measured + 6 new (q21-24 read-side should-trigger; q25-26 read-shaped should-not near-misses). Empirical step = independent fan-out of 26 fresh-context agents, one per query, each shown a neutral menu of 9 skill descriptions (kid-authoring at C among realistic siblings, NOT flagged as under-test; sibling authoring skills shown with abridged versions of their own new read-framed descriptions, matching deployment) + one query, asked which ONE skill to load (or NONE) + reasoning. Verdicts adjudicated from each agent's REASONING + pick. Menu: A=SkyPatcher edit-record-fields, B=SPID distribute-to-NPCs, C=KID keywords-to-items [under test], D=CID items-to-containers, E=mutagen-reference record-schema, F=crash-diagnostics, G=conflict-resolution, H=papyrus-reference, I=modding-basics. Menu + raw run-record in dev/skill-validation/2026-06-11-read-triggers/ (private). Supersedes the 2026-06-04 run (whose 20 queries are q1-q20 here, all verdicts reconfirmed; the C/D letter-adjacency wobble noted in that run did not recur).

result.notes: All 14 should-trigger picked C — the 10 originals (write-side, reconfirmed; q6's trimmed 'destruction spell tomes' phrase still fires via books + 'tag all ... with a keyword') and all 4 new read-side cases: q21 does-this-_KID-tag-X, q22 pre-install read-which-items-it-tags, q23 why-isn't-the-line-applying, q24 audit-for-double-tagging (agent also cited ExclusiveGroup). All 12 should-not routed elsewhere, incl. the two new read-shaped near-misses: q25 (what does this _DISTR.ini distribute → B) and q26 (what does this skypatcher ini change → A) — framework beat read-verb both times. Hard originals all held: q14 keyword-to-NPCs → B (the KID/SPID boundary), q18 scripted keyword-on-pickup → H, q19/q20 name KID but are install/conceptual → I. Every manual_predicted_trigger matched the measured verdict.

revalidation_2026-07-28_294.method: 2026-07-28 revalidation for issue #294 (all 13 descriptions compressed to the amended section-3.5 200-400 char target): section-6.5 fan-out, one fresh-context sonnet (low effort) agent per query, each shown the full lettered menu of all 13 NEW descriptions (under-test skill unflagged, letter J) plus NONE, asked which ONE to load; one opus adjudicator per skill scored from reasoning per section-6.5 step 4. No fable-model agents. Conductor session: #294 worktree.

misses.query: i'm new to modding, what even is KID and do i need it for my load order
misses.diagnosis: J's description names KID by full product name and covers "asks what an existing `_KID.ini` does", so a general "what is KID / do I need it" orientation question reads as in-scope; nothing else on the menu covers mod-explainer/install questions, so J absorbs it by default.

revalidation_2026-07-28_294.adjudicator_notes: Recall 14/14 (ids 1-10, 21-24) — every recall row picked J and the reasoning cited the KID keyword-on-items capability explicitly, no reasoning/pick mismatches. Specificity 11/12; the near-miss neighbours all held: SPID rows (11, 14, 25) went to E with reasoning that correctly cited "keywords on NPCs are SPID"; SkyPatcher rows (12, 26) went to B even when the query said "add a keyword", so J's "editing a record's own fields is SkyPatcher" disclaimer is doing its job; the Papyrus keyword row (18) went to C. Only id 20 leaked, and it is the benign kind — a general "what is KID" question landing on the KID skill is arguably correct behaviour rather than a description defect; no reasoning-over-pick overrides were needed anywhere.
revalidation_2026-07-28_294.contamination_audit_2026-07-28: 2026-07-28 PR #295 review follow-up (contamination audit): the independent review found adjudicator notes quoting text that exists only in the PRE-compression descriptions. Forensics on the run journal established: (a) judges were shown the NEW menu (the loader agent's journaled return contains it verbatim); (b) 11 of 281 judge rows leaked OLD description text from the agents' own environment skill listing (the installed plugin) into their reasoning; (c) separately, some opus adjudicator notes confabulated 'verbatim quotes' from that same stale environment. All contaminated rows were re-judged with a hardened prompt (explicit stale-environment warning): 15/15 confirmed their original verdicts, except dialogue-authoring q19, whose recorded MISS was itself a contamination artifact and is overturned. Treat quoted description text in the run-1 adjudicator_notes above as unreliable where it does not appear in the shipped description; scores are pick-derived and were confirmed by the hardened re-run. Skill-specific: q1, q7, q12, q26 re-judged hardened: all unchanged.
